description: This file defines an abstract test case class for unit testing within the OrangeHRM project. It provides utility methods for setting up mock services, creating HTTP request objects, and managing dependencies and environment setup for tests. The class uses traits and integrates various core services to facilitate testing of the system's components in isolation or integrated scenarios.

classes.name: KernelTestCase
classes.description: An abstract PHPUnit test case class for setting up and managing dependencies and environment for OrangeHRM system tests.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Cleans up after a test by clearing the entity manager and recreating the kernel.

methods.name: getHttpRequest
methods.description: Creates and returns a new HTTP Request object with specified parameters.

methods.name: createKernel
methods.description: Sets up the application kernel with necessary mock services and environment for testing.

methods.name: createKernelWithMockServices
methods.description: Creates the kernel and injects specified mock services into the container.

methods.name: updateOptions
methods.description: Updates internal options array to modify kernel setup behavior.

methods.name: setHelperServices
methods.description: Mocks and sets auxiliary helper services used during testing.

methods.name: setBaseServices
methods.description: Sets core application services into the container for testing.
